subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server session wedges indefinitely after a 429 rate-limit burst — terminal-idle watchdog still gated by `activeAppServerTurnRequests > 0` (regression/incomplete fix of #82681)

question: Is current main's structural Codex app-server liveness fix sufficient to close this issue before live 429 proof exists on a release containing the run-lifecycle stack?
rationale: Source, tests, and Codex protocol evidence indicate the wedge class should be bounded now, but the latest human status and current ClawSweeper review explicitly keep this issue open for release/live 429 confirmation.

options.title: Keep for release live proof

options.title: Close as implemented on main
options.body: Close now based on structural source, Codex protocol, and test proof, accepting that any persistent 429 wedge should reopen this issue or file a new one with traces.
